translations.text: Jude, servant of Jesus Christ and brother of James, to you, the called, sanctified by God the Father and kept by Jesus Christ:
May mercy be with you, and may peace and love be multiplied!

Beloved, I made every haste to write to you concerning our common salvation. It seemed necessary to me to write to you, and I beseech you to contend for the faith that was once delivered to the saints.
For certain men have crept in, who were written down long ago for this judgment, ungodly men, who turn the grace of our God into impurity and deny the only Master, God, and our Lord Jesus Christ.
I wish to remind you, though you know all this, that God once saved the people from the land of Egypt, but afterward destroyed those who did not believe.
And the angels who did not keep their own principality, but abandoned their dwelling, he has kept under darkness in everlasting bonds for the judgment of the great day.

Just as Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities around them, which in the same manner as these committed fornication and went after strange flesh, are set forth as an example of eternal fire, having received punishment.
In the same way these also see visions, defile the flesh, despise lordships, and blaspheme glories.
But Michael the archangel, when he disputed with the devil and argued about the body of Moses, did not dare to bring a judgment of blasphemy upon him, but said: "May the Lord rebuke you."
But these men blaspheme whatever they do not know, and whatever they know by nature, like brute beasts, by these things they are corrupted.
Woe to them! For they walk in the way of Cain, and they were carried away in the error of Balaam for reward, and they perished in the rebellion of Korah.

These are the ones who, defiled, feast together with you at your love feasts and fearlessly shepherd themselves: waterless clouds carried about by the wind, fruitless winter trees, twice dead, pulled up by the roots,
raging waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame, wandering stars, for whom the eternal gloom of darkness is reserved.
Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied about them and said: "Behold, the Lord has come with myriads of his saints

to execute judgment upon all, and to convict all the ungodly concerning all their works of ungodliness which they committed lawlessly, and concerning all the harsh words which ungodly sinners have spoken against him."
These are grumblers and faultfinders, walking according to their own desires, and their mouth speaks arrogant things; they show partiality to persons for the sake of gain.
But you, beloved, remember the words spoken beforehand by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.
For they told you that in the last times there would be scoffers, walking according to their own ungodly desires.
These are the ones who separate themselves, worldly (soulish) men, who do not have the Spirit.
But you, beloved, build yourselves up on your holy faith; pray in the Holy Spirit.
Keep yourselves in the love of God, and wait for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto life.
And have mercy on some who are in doubt,
And some you should save with fear, snatching them out as if from fire. Hate even the garment that has been defiled by the flesh.
Now to him who is able to keep you without sin and to set you blameless before his glory with joy,
to the only wise God, our Savior, be glory and riches, strength and authority, before all ages, and now and forever and ever. Amen.
